description: This file defines a wizard for selecting and completing a sale order in the point of sale module of an OpenERP/Odoo system. It includes form XML, business logic for completing a sale, and a wizard interface class.

classes.name: pos_sale_get
classes.description: Wizard interface class for handling sale order selection and completion

methods.name: _sale_complete
methods.description: Handles the logic to finalize a sale order, including validation, updating related records, and creating order lines
